title: AuditEvent
description: Schema for immutable platform audit log events.

event_id.description: Unique prefixed identifier for the audit event

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation

user_id.description: Identifier of the actor initiating the operation

action.description: Canonical action identifier (e.g. asset.create, scan.start, remediation.approve)

entity_type.description: Type of the entity being acted upon

entity_id.description: Identifier of the entity being acted upon

status.description: Outcome status of the audited operation

metadata.description: Sanitized contextual information (IP address, request ID, user agent)
